files.content: # SidebarShell examples The signed-in frame in four layouts: an expanded frosted sidebar, a collapsible icon rail, a header-only top nav, and a drawer on narrow screens. ```tsx import { SidebarShell } from "@/components/shell/SidebarShell"; } nav={[ { href: "/dashboard", label: "Dashboard", icon: , exact: true }, { href: "/projects", label: "Projects", icon: , count: 2 }, ]} title="Projects" topbarRight={} collapsible storageKey="app-sidebar-collapsed" > {children} ``` ## Sidebar expanded (logo corner: match glass) ```tsx … ``` ## Collapsible, remembered The panel button folds the sidebar to the icon rail and back. storageKey keeps the choice across reloads. ```tsx console.log("collapsed", collapsed)} navLabel="Main" nav={NAV} title="Projects" > … ``` ## Collapsed to an icon rail layout="rail" starts collapsed. With collapsible it can still be expanded. ```tsx }> … ``` ## Header only (top nav) No sidebar: the logo, the nav and topbarRight share one frosted bar. ```tsx }> … ``` ## Mobile drawer Below 900px the sidebar is a drawer from the menu button. Shown open here with forceMobile and defaultDrawerOpen. ```tsx // Automatic below 900px of the frame's width. For a preview at desktop width: … // Keep the icon rail on narrow screens instead of a drawer: … ``` ## Logo corner: brand fill Opt in for brands that require a set colour behind the logo. Set the colour with --logo-corner-bg (a colour or a gradient). ```tsx … /* theme.css */ :root { --logo-corner-bg: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f766e, #0b5c56); --logo-corner-ink: #ffffff; } ``` ## With a context strip ```tsx … ``` Docs: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/sidebar-shell
